_comment: The two files that decide whether a file operation's outcome was handled, and the gate that says which emitted COBOL two engines have both executed. `BANK-FILE-017` is a published compiler guarantee, and a guarantee whose logic nobody has mutated is a claim. Its own lane because the aggregate of the rules lane hides it: file-outcomes.ts scored 63.73 inside a run that reported 78 overall, with 68 surviving mutants and five real holes among them. See docs/verification.md.
_disableTypeChecks_comment: A pattern rather than the default `true`, which reaches HTML as well. Stryker inserts `// @ts-nocheck` into every `<script>` of a sandboxed .html file and moves its closing tag, so `packages/playground/index.html` arrived at the dry run with a mangled menu script and `tests/site-layout.test.ts` failed before a single mutant was tested. No lane mutates HTML, so no lane needs type checks disabled in it.
_incremental_comment: Off, deliberately. Stryker's incremental cache is keyed on the code it mutates, and this lane exists to measure whether the *tests* are worth anything, so a test-only change must re-measure.
